- Overestimate prices in bullish sentiment periods (high sentiment > 0.5) — reduce forecast by 2–5% for 30d horizon.
- Underestimate prices after sharp spikes (e.g., >75.0) — adjust downward by 3–8% to avoid overcorrection.
- Overshoot early in 30d forecast when sentiment is neutral or slightly bearish — cap forecast at 1–2% below recent 18d high.
- Mean-reversion bias: if 30d forecast is >10% above 18d average, reduce by 5–10% unless sentiment strongly bullish.
- Lagged sentiment effect: if sentiment drops below 0.2 in last 3 days, reduce forecast by 3–6% to reflect weakening momentum.
- Avoid “over-optimism” in early 30d forecast — first 5 days should be conservative, aligning with 18d moving average.
